name: Apply Door Frame Finish (Brush Method)
intent: Brush finish coat onto primed door frame. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between. Brush preserves the traditional residential finish look — brush marks are acceptable and expected.
doctrine: Coat 1 at 4 frames/hr (15 min each) is slower than coat 2 at 5 frames/hr (12 min each) — same pattern as trim brush finish (80 LF/hr → 90 LF/hr). Frame painting involves working all six surfaces (two jamb faces, head jamb face, stop molding, door-facing edges). Spray rates roughly 4x these in MOD_APPLY_DOOR_FRAME_FINISH_SPRAY.
